# Load subtype assignment and clinical data
```{r load subtype assignment and clinical data}
visit_max = 6; n_factor = 40
nclust_tree_all = 6
subtype_hcl = readRDS("~/impacc/Analysis/molecular_subtyping/code/Fig1/src/subtype_hcl.rds")
clin_data_aligned = readRDS("~/impacc/Analysis/molecular_subtyping/code/Fig1/src/clin_data_aligned.rds")
extended_data = readRDS("~/impacc/Analysis/molecular_subtyping/code/Fig1/src/extended_data.rds")
X = extended_data$X
clin_data_patient = clin_data_aligned[clin_data_aligned$event_type == "Visit 1",]
demo_data_adjust = clin_data_patient[, c("discretized_admit_age_quantile", 
                                         "sex")]
```

# Generate null data
```{r generate null data}
generate_null_data <- function(X) {
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  nrow_X <- nrow(X)
  ncol_X <- ncol(X)
  null_data <- matrix(nrow = nrow_X, ncol = ncol_X)
  for (i in 1:ncol_X) {
    column_data <- X[, i]
    col_mean <- mean(column_data, na.rm = TRUE)
    col_sd <- sd(column_data, na.rm = TRUE)
    # generate random numbers with the same mean and sd as the current column
    null_data[, i] <- rnorm(nrow_X, mean = col_mean, sd = col_sd)
    # preserve NA values
    null_data[is.na(column_data), i] <- NA
  }

  return(null_data)
}

set.seed(123)
n_iter <- 1000
model_loglik_values <- numeric(n_iter)
model_AIC_values <- numeric(n_iter)
for (i in 1:n_iter) {
  print(i)
  X_null <- generate_null_data(X)
  dist_mat_null <- calculate_distance_matrix(X_null, n_factor, visit_max = visit_max)
  hcl_null <- hclust(d = dist_mat_null, method = "ward.D2")
  subtype_null <- cutree(hcl_null, k = 6)
  test_tg_null <- test_ordinal_demo(
    subtype = subtype_null,
    response = subtype_hcl$TG,
    demo_data = demo_data_adjust
  )
  
  model_loglik_values[i] <- as.numeric(test_tg_null$model_loglik)
  model_AIC_values[i] <- as.numeric(test_tg_null$model_AIC)
}
```

# Log-likelihood comparison (S2)
```{r log-likelihood comparison, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
full_test <- test_ordinal_demo(
  subtype = subtype_hcl$label,
  response = subtype_hcl$TG,
  demo_data = demo_data_adjust)

df_loglik <- data.frame(value = model_loglik_values)
ggplot(df_loglik, aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), binwidth = 0.4, 
                 color = "black", fill = "gray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.numeric(full_test$model_loglik), 
             color = "darkblue", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.6) +
  annotate("text", x = max(df_loglik$value)+20, y = 0.2, label = "Null Data", 
           color = "black", size = 6) +
  annotate("text", x = full_test$model_loglik-20, y = 0.2, label = "True Data", 
           color = "darkblue", size = 6) +
  labs(title = "Histogram of Log-Likelihood Values", 
       x = "Log-Likelihood Values", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15, color = "black"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15, color = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15, color = "black"),
        axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 1),
        axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 1),
        title = element_text(size = 15, color = "black"))
```
